tests.frontend_scope: Initial state and every phase through five completed months
dimensions: Identical initial accounts and bank balance
Equivalent initial physical production, energy spending and staffing plan
Same first household budget; actual purchases change with lot size
Machine cash price, delivery quantity and productivity converted together
Independent account reconstruction at every posting with fine goods, machine credit and a closure

comparison.reference_profile: 25 percent distribution tax with adaptive fiscal policy

figure.visual_review: Eight full-horizon panels checked; common legend outside data; trailing 12-month means identified

scope_limits: All goods quantities use finer resolution, including production, inventory and demand rounding; household checkout rounding alone is not separately identified
No external shocks; cent rounding of energy price changes is not tested by the comparison
Default remains one original goods unit
No credit-cap breach within 600 months does not establish unlimited fiscal sustainability
